methodologyMarkdown:
## Overview
The Universal Postal Union publications area is a server-rendered CMS site. The landing page at /en/Publications features a few highlighted items plus an 'All Publications' link to the full catalogue at /en/universal-postal-union/activities/research-publications/all-publications, which should be used as the browse root.

## Search
No dedicated publications search endpoint was verified, so the search capability is not claimed. Discovery is via the All-Publications listing and category grouping (think-tank briefs, regional development plans, etc.).

## Filters
Publications are organized by category in the URL path (/en/publications/{category}/...). These act as browse facets rather than a queryable filter API; no formal schema declared.

## Download
Cards link to record pages at /en/publications/{category}/{issue}/{slug}. The PDF is exposed on the record page, not the landing page, so a two-step crawl is required.

## Metadata & Enrichment
Title, publication date and category are in server-rendered HTML. No JSON/REST API; enrichment is HTML-based.

## Limitations
The /en/Publications landing surfaces only a few featured items; the real catalogue is behind the 'All Publications' link. No verified search endpoint. Pagination behavior on the all-publications listing should be confirmed at crawl time. Behind a CDN; use a realistic User-Agent.
